scripts.// db:seed:leagues:jdl-v3: Seed staging with the [JDL v3] leagues for the 2026-08-22 retest guide: scoring formula, flex sessions, draft sheet + manual pairing, full league, player side, waitlist (requires STAGING_DB_URL)
scripts.// db:seed:leagues:jdl-share: Seed staging with the [JDL v2] Partage leagues + pre-minted share links (prints the URLs to send Jean; requires STAGING_DB_URL)
scripts.// db:seed:leagues:sessions: Seed staging with [SEED-S] leagues covering the full session loop: publish, confirm, match sheet, score, ranking (requires STAGING_DB_URL)
scripts.// db:seed:tournaments:staging: Seed staging with [SEED-T] tournaments covering every lifecycle state, brackets, doubles, pickleball and the participant flows (requires STAGING_DB_URL)
scripts.// db:seed:paid-e2e:staging: Seed staging with the [PAYE2E] paid end-to-end set: no fake ledger rows, meant to be charged with a real Stripe test card (requires STAGING_DB_URL)
scripts.// db:seed:tournaments:pools: Seed staging with [JDL-PK] 7-12: the pool_knockout cases the tester cannot reach from the app (uneven pools, forfeit, cancelled game, doubles, one qualifier per pool, 32-player draw, pickleball) and re-arm the clocks on 1-6 (requires STAGING_DB_URL)
